profile.headline: Full Stack Developer
profile.summary:
Versatile software developer with a strong foundation in web development, experienced in both front-end and back-end technologies. I began my academic journey in 2014 at the University of Kentucky, majoring in Computer Science and minoring in Computer Engineering and Mathematics, driven by the natural synergy in their coursework. My passion for programming sparked when a favorite game was discontinued—motivating me to rebuild it from scratch. That project became a turning point, fueling my dedication to software development.

Professionally, I started as a Support Developer, quickly progressed into a managerial role, and now serve as a Full Software Developer focused on enhancing and maintaining client websites. I'm skilled in building scalable, maintainable applications and thrive on creating clean, user-centered solutions. Outside of work, I actively pursue hands-on projects that challenge me to grow technically and creatively, staying committed to continuous learning and improvement.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: I developed, updated, and maintained multiple WordPress websites, ensuring consistent branding and adherence to functionality standards. I also contributed to the redevelopment of a C# web application by enhancing user interfaces and implementing new features to improve user experience. Additionally, I collaborated on modernizing a legacy PHP application by redesigning the front end with Angular and migrating the back end to C# with Azure integration.

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description: I configured multi-server environments to ensure high uptime, performance, and scalability. I managed hundreds of hosting accounts across diverse infrastructures, including IIS, cPanel, and Google Cloud. Additionally, I provided technical support and implemented server-side optimizations to enhance the performance of existing client websites.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: I developed custom websites using the LAMP stack, working across several proprietary CMS platforms to deliver tailored solutions. I launched multiple client-focused WordPress sites, aligning functionality and design with specific business objectives. Throughout each project, I participated in the full lifecycle—from planning and development to launch and ongoing post-launch support.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Computer Engineering, Computer Science and Mathematics

honors.title: William C Parker Scholarship
honors.description: I being a minority student was given this scholarship based on my academics. This scholarship gives me 20,000 dollars for tuition as long as I can keep my GPA above 3.0. I am currently in good standings with this scholarship.
honors.issuer: Issued by university of kentucky · Aug 2014
